name: nericx
description: Link and listen to music with osu!

scripts.dev:electron: npm run transpile:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.package:win: npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 --optional && npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs --platform linux --arch x64 --optional && npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && node scripts/stamp-ffmpeg.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && node scripts/verify-ffmpeg.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
